fullDescription: A neutral, corporate-grade AI chat interface designed for security-focused SaaS, developer tools, and fintech platforms. The aesthetic is strictly minimalist and professional, utilizing a deep grayscale palette (ranging from #111113 to #1f1f23) with subtle slate accents. It features editorial-quality typography with General Sans for UI and Cabinet Grotesk for branding, combined with functional monospace for code blocks. Key characteristics include a clean sidebar-main layout, flat design principles with zero gradients or ambient glows, and high-precision micro-interactions like message slide-ins and bounce typing indicators.
prompt:
## Resumo
RagIndex AI Chat Style: A professional, dark-mode 'Neutral Corporate' interface. It uses a monochromatic gray scale, crisp typography, and subtle borders to convey trust and technical precision. The design avoids all decorative flourishes, focusing on functional hierarchy and clear readability.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a neutral corporate dark-mode theme. Colors: Background #111113, Surface #18181b, Elevated Surface #1f1f23, Input Area #1c1c20. Borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07). Text: Primary #e8e8ea, Secondary #8b8b90, Dim #4b4b52. Typography: Body/UI 'General Sans' (weights: 400, 500, 600), Logo 'Cabinet Grotesk' (weight: 700), Code 'JetBrains Mono'. Avoid all gradients, shadows, and glows. Interaction: Buttons should transition background-color and border-color over 0.15s ease. Message animation: fade and slide up 6px over 0.25s. Scrollbars should be thin (3px) and translucent white.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar Navigation
Width: 252px. Background: #18181b. Border-right: 1px solid #1f1f23. Top: Logo section with a terminal icon in a 30px #1f1f23 square. Middle: 'New conversation' button (100% width minus margins, background #1f1f23, weight 500). Scrollable chat history list: Items have 12.5px font-size, 8px padding, and use 1px vertical margin; active item background #1f1f23 with 1px border. Bottom: User profile row with a 30px circular avatar and Pro/Plan labels.

### Main Topbar
Height: 60px approx. Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07). Left side: Model selector dropdown styled as a pill button (#1f1f23 background) with a small green #4ade80 status dot. Right side: Cluster of three 34px icon-only buttons (Search, Share, Settings) and a user avatar AK.

### Message Feed
Centered layout with max-width 700px for content. User messages: Right-aligned, text inside a #1f1f23 bubble with 12px border-radius and slightly sharper top-right corner. AI messages: Left-aligned, no bubble, 13.5px text, line-height 1.72. Every message row must have a 28px avatar (AI logo or user initials). Action buttons (Copy, Thumbs, Refresh) appear on hover below AI responses in a row, using 10.5px text and 1px borders.

### Chat Input Area
Pinned to bottom, background #111113 with 1px top border. Container: Centered, max-width 800px. Input Wrapper: #1c1c20 background, 12px border-radius, 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12). Structure: Top-row textarea (auto-growing to 160px) and a 32px square send button; Bottom-row utility toolbar with text-based buttons (Attach, Docs, Web) and a 10.5px character counter.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neutral Code Block — A developer-friendly code display with low-contrast syntax highlighting.
Container: background #0e0e10, border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 8px border-radius. Header: 7px padding, background rgba(255,255,255,0.02), font-size 11px, shows filename and a 'copy' button. Content: monospace font, size 12px, line-height 1.65. Keywords: #d4d4d8, Strings: #a1a1aa, Comments: #4b4b52 italic.

### Model Selector Pill — A professional toggle for switching AI models with status indicators.
Background #1f1f23, 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12), padding 6px 12px, border-radius 8px. Includes a 6px circular green (#4ade80) status indicator. Text font-size 13px, font-weight 500, color #e8e8ea. Chevron-down icon on the right.

### Typing Indicator — Subtle bounce animation for pending AI responses.
Flex row of 3 dots. Dot size: 5px. Color: #4b4b52. Animation: Each dot bounces up 3px and fades in opacity from 0.25 to 0.75 using an infinite 1.3s loop with 0.15s stagger delay.

## Notas Especiais
Must-dos: Ensure all edges are crisp; use subtle 1px borders to define all sections instead of shadows. Maintain high density with 12px-13.5px font sizes. Must-nots: Do not use vibrant colors or saturated gradients. Avoid rounded corners exceeding 12px except for circular avatars.

style.description: The style essence is 'Industrial Professionalism'. It relies on high contrast between deep backgrounds (#111113) and off-white text (#e8e8ea). Typography uses 'General Sans' for modern readability and 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold headers. Borders are ultra-thin (1px) and translucent (rgba(255,255,255,0.07)), creating structural depth without visual noise. All animations are short (120ms-250ms) and use standard ease curves to maintain a snappy, tool-like feel.
